title: 对话主题作为社会人口统计的代理：对话上下文如何影响LLM回答
summary: 研究表明，在高风险场景（如法律、医疗、金融建议）中，LLM难以从单次对话历史推断用户社会人口统计特征，但对话主题是预测LLM生成建议的主要因素，其作为社会人口统计的代理，以不可预测的方式影响输出，引发对对话上下文影响的担忧。
summary_en: Research shows that in high-stakes scenarios (legal, medical, financial advice), LLMs struggle to infer user sociodemographics from a single conversation history, but conversation topics are the main predictor of LLM-generated advice, acting as proxies for sociodemographic groups and affecting outputs unpredictably, raising concerns about conversational context influence.
